observations.source: Controller of Budget, County Governments Budget Implementation Review Report FY 2024/25, section 3.38 (Siaya)
observations.note: The report states: the county generated KSh 436.68 million from its revenue sources, including health facility financing (FIF). That was 2 per cent more than KSh 427.95 million in FY 2023/24 and 47 per cent of the annual target. Press reports give the same figure. The report also says the own-source revenue included KSh 290 million of arrears; how that splits the total is not clear from the text.

observations.source: Siaya County Secretary statement, as reported by K24 Digital
observations.note: Other statements say the county raised over KSh 900 million. The county's own document has not been read, so what it counts is unknown. The figure is close to the annual target implied by the Controller of Budget report (about KSh 929 million), which may explain it, but that is not established.

trend.caveat: Each year comes from a different Controller of Budget report, and the reports count revenue slightly differently. FY 2022/23 is a total of own-source revenue (KSh 402.23 million) and appropriations-in-aid (KSh 105.81 million). FY 2023/24 and FY 2024/25 include health facility financing. Compare years with care.

target.source: Controller of Budget, County Governments Budget Implementation Review Report FY 2024/25, section 3.38 (Siaya)
target.description: Own-source revenue counted in the approved budget financing: about KSh 1.04 billion, made up of KSh 643 million to be deposited into the County Revenue Fund and KSh 400 million as Appropriations-in-Aid spent at source.
target.note: The report says Siaya collected 47 per cent of its annual target. 436.68 divided by 0.47 gives about KSh 929 million, which is lower than the KSh 1,043 million in the budget financing. The report does not explain the difference.

pending_bills.note: The county reported KSh 1.12 billion pending at 30 June 2024 and settled KSh 577.7 million during FY 2024/25. The closing balance at 30 June 2025 could not be read reliably from the OCR text and is not shown.

stalled_projects.note: The county reported nine stalled development projects as of 30 June 2025. The project list in the PDF could not be read reliably, so individual projects are not shown.
